projects.title: Cool Compiler
projects.description: A compiler for the Cool programming language, consisting of lexer, parser, and backend code generation. Coded in Java utilising the visitor design pattern, with full test coverage for each component.

projects.title: PRISM App
projects.description: A web app that lets users upload and enhance images with a wide variety of filters. Features a clean and intuitive interface, with the ability to save, manage, and enjoy edited images.

projects.title: Github Stats App
projects.description: A React app that fetches a user's repositories and displays their first commit. Built with async/await and the GitHub API, it dynamically retrieves data and gives users instant feedback.

projects.title: CIFAR-10 Image Classifier
projects.description: An image classifier with a custom architecture, utilising knowledge learnt from a Neural Networks & Deep Learning module. Attained 91% accuracy on the CIFAR-10 dataset.

projects.title: Image Processing Application
projects.description: An Image processing application for processing a single image with filters or filtering between two images. Also includes the ability to select a Region of Interest (ROI) and apply multiple filters onto a single image.

projects.title: Never Upon a Time
projects.description: Follow the protagonist through a surreal realm inspired by Alice in Wonderland, navigating Victorian streets, opulent mansions, and bizarre spaces in search of a lost cat named Seren.

projects.title: Portfolio Site V2.0
projects.description: My personal portfolio site, the one you're viewing now. Coded in pure JavaScript, HTML & CSS, and utilising Jekyll for static site generation, a platform to showcase projects.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: A weather app coded in React with a stylish GUI and weather information obtained through an API. Designed for tourists it has clothing and accessory recommendations based on the weather.

projects.title: Adventure Game
projects.description: A turn-based adventure game coded in Java and utilising the Swing API to create the GUI. The player can attack, heal or talk to a series of enemies.
